Counter vs rows seen: page claims 9758 total shipments; 5 individual shipment rows were visible on the free view (dates 2026-02-24 to 2026-02-28), plus aggregated partner tables (ZANKER MFG LLC 619, GES GRAPHITE INC. 401, HYUNDAI STEEL COMPANY 10000+, ANTORA ENERGY 282, TOKAI COBEX POLSKA 232) and port counts (MANDIDEEP ICD INMDD6 740, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 152). Declared HS 854511 confirmed by the Kuwait electrode row (85451100); the US rows show 38011000 (graphite articles, not 854590) — HS partially corrected, not a rejection ground.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrievable: hegltd.com returned HTTP 403, screener.in and moneycontrol returned 404/403, BSE page returned no financial content. Only indirect public statement found (Tickertape company profile, https://www.tickertape.in/stocks/heg-HEG): "HEG Limited is engaged in manufacturing of graphite electrodes, which are used by manufacturers of steel. The Company's segments include Graphite, Power and Unallocable items." and earnings-call summary "stand-alone revenue and total income both up 11% year on year ... high utilization above 91% ... diversified export base spanning about 30 countries". This is a company/analyst statement, not a shipment or GST record — hence declared_only. Revenue figure: consolidated revenue ~₹2.83 thousand crore per Tickertape forecast block ("2026 Current ₹2.83 ... Thousand cr.") — treat as approximate, exact audited FY figure not verified (null).
note: Real export shipments confirmed by dated customs/B-L records: 85451100 UHP graphite electrodes to Kuwait (BOL 1021582, 2026-02-25) and graphite blocks to the USA (BOL 1140562, 2026-02-28), 9758 total shipment records, 170 trading partners, 127 port lanes. Declared HS 854511 is correct for the electrode line; the US graphite-product line is 38011000, so the HS set should be recorded as 854511 + 380110 rather than 854590. Domestic supply: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract document could be opened (company site 403, financial portals blocked), so domestic side is 'declared_only' — revenue and Indian-market sales exist per company/analyst statements but were not verified against a primary record. No rejection grounds: legal entity active and listed (NSE: HEGAM, formerly HEG), no liquidation/bankruptcy found.
